displayName: Nextier Substage Sapphire Sept3 Processing Manifest V2
description: Per-well progress for the Sapphire workflow, matching nextier_substage_silver_aug27_processing_manifest_v1. This is what makes skip_completed and well-wise resumption work -- without it every re-run starts from scratch.
sql: SELECT CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS manifest_id, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS run_id, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS workflow_name, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS mode, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS source_datastore_key, name AS well_name, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS requested_start_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS requested_end_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS effective_start_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS effective_end_ts, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS chunk_hours, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS chunk_index, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS stage_rows, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS label_rows, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS window_rows, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS algorithm_version, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS status, CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS dry_run, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS started_at, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS completed_at FROM datastore:merged_fleet_stream_customer_full_v2 WHERE 1 = 0

manifest_id.description: Unique id for the run/well slice.

effective_start_ts.description: Window actually covered after context expansion.

effective_end_ts.description: Window actually covered after context expansion.

window_rows.description: Refined titanium substage window rows written.

dry_run.description: True when the run computed but deliberately wrote nothing.
